key_recovered_lessons: Search trajectory is not enough; representation and live interface are independent algorithmic objects.
A cheap-to-verify certificate can still be expensive to discover; certificate-language discovery must be charged.
Exact knowledge should be retained in a content-addressed proof DAG with provenance and paid canonicalization/serialization.
A scalar hint such as epsilon=4 or a fingerprint cannot stand in for the full typed exact state.
An exact nonterminal fact must yield a replayable future-state projection or remain non-authoritative for search reduction.
Cross-language composition requires an exact boundary certificate.
OPEN receipts must preserve an immutable exact frontier witness and capability digest.
Pippi/Keymaster/M2R/Spider adaptive machinery belongs in representation-language selection too, with delayed learning and exact fallback.
Fingerprint/state spectrum ranks candidates but is not identity or truth.
MAD-LAB should attack representation, discovery and interface growth, not only wall-clock difficulty.
